repository.scope: All blobs reachable from all local Git refs
repository.literal_assignment_review: The heuristic surfaced only dynamic parameter/property/runtime-generation references in code; no literal credential value was identified. Values were not copied into the report.

credential_provenance.generation: tests/candidate-runtime/run_candidate.py generates per-run values with secrets.token_urlsafe(28) under the private WORK/secrets directory (directory mode 0700; files mode 0600).
credential_provenance.build_context: The fixture creates a temporary build context from candidate/security, candidate/cargotracker, and tests/candidate-runtime only; the private WORK/secrets directory is outside the copied context.
credential_provenance.image_copy_rules: tests/candidate-runtime/Dockerfile copies source, test observer artifacts, and startup/configuration scripts; it does not COPY generated credential files.
credential_provenance.runtime_delivery: The fixture mounts the private directory read-only at /run/kan18. tests/candidate-runtime/start.sh copies the realm files into the running container at startup; this occurs after image creation.

result: No credential files or high-confidence credential formats were found in reachable Git blobs. The exact candidate image has no credential-named environment settings or secret-setting build history, and its build/runtime provenance excludes generated credentials from the image.
limitations: The Git scan uses a documented set of high-confidence formats and a redacted literal-assignment heuristic; it is not a comprehensive commercial secret scanner.

The image's compressed layer bytes were not exhaustively scanned. Image exclusion is supported by matching the image digest to the fresh run, inspecting image configuration/history, and verifying the build-context and runtime-mount provenance.
This is local synthetic-candidate evidence, not a production image or deployment claim.
